specialThanks.heading: Special Thanks
specialThanks.intro: With deepest gratitude, we recognize those whose extraordinary support has quietly and powerfully shaped this ministry.

entries.name: Valued Friends
entries.body: Old and new, who see the vision God has given us, who have encouraged us by attending our events, inviting us to sing, worshipping and singing alongside us, eagerly awaiting the advancement of our ministry, and faithfully praying for us, you are a blessing!

entries.name: Needles SDA Church
entries.body: Your constant love, prayerful support, valued input in song choices, and the arena to strengthen and refine our music skills bless us beyond measure! It's an honor to serve alongside you as music leader and elder.

entries.name: Allen Howard
entries.body: The Candle Studio, Needles, CA. Producer and sound engineer of our music project, "In The Beginning." Your belief in us and our God-given mission has never wavered. Your friendship, guidance, well-honed ear, audio skills and the 'patience of the saints' has brought our first music project to life.

becomeAPartner.heading: Become a Partner
becomeAPartner.body: We can't do this alone, and we were never meant to. If you feel connected to this ministry and what it represents, we invite you to become a monthly partner. Your support helps us continue showing up, pouring out, and reaching others with consistency and care. You're not just giving, you're joining the mission.

fineprint.heading: 501(c)(3) Statement
paragraphs: Last Song Ministry operates independently of 501(c)(3) tax-exempt status. This is a deliberate and prayerful decision. When an organization incorporates as a 501(c)(3), it becomes a government-recognized entity subject to state and federal oversight, including restrictions on speech, activities, and organizational governance. In effect, the organization becomes accountable to the state as a condition of its tax-exempt standing.

We believe our ministry is called and commissioned by God, and we answer to His authority alone. After careful study and prayer, we have chosen not to place our ministry under the regulatory authority of any government entity. We serve under the government of God, not the government of man, and we want to ensure that nothing hinders our ability to follow His leading without compromise.

We hold no judgment toward other ministries that have chosen differently. Many faithful organizations operate effectively under 501(c)(3) status, and we respect their decision to do so. This is simply the path God has laid on our hearts for Last Song Ministry.

Because of this, donations to Last Song Ministry are not tax-deductible. We trust that those who give do so as an act of worship and obedience to God, and we are deeply grateful for every gift that helps us continue this work.
